exposure: haemoglobin levels (normal, mild anemia, moderate anemia, severe anemia)
blood pressure (normal, mild pre-eclampsia, severe pre-eclampsia, eclampsia, HELLP syndrome)
cohort: 100 confirmed cases of intrauterine fetal demise (IUFD) at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The study investigated the probable causes of IUFD and found associations with maternal factors like BMI, haemoglobin levels, and blood pressure.
